name: The Bog: the crossing
_note: Terrence 2026-11-08: the Bog is playable. Same run as the Lava crossing; the stones are tussocks, sunken logs and peat. Wispling, Nixie, Tiddy Mun (in place of a chest), Bog-draugr, then the Wisp King and Queen and Jenny Greenteeth. 2026-11-12: a second heart stone (step 7, the stone just past Tiddy Mun, was a chest): the Bog asks more questions that can cost a heart than the other crossings (four monsters).
